Application Data.NAME: Creative Visions LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Visions LLC is a full-service graphic design agency specializing in branding, print design, and digital marketing solutions. Our team of skilled artists and designers work closely with clients to create visually compelling materials that effectively communicate their brand message and engage their target audience. We offer services such as logo design, promotional materials, packaging design, and web graphics, ensuring that each project is tailored to meet the unique needs of the client. With a commitment to creativity and excellence, we strive to deliver high-quality designs that enhance our clients' market presence.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a client claimed that the digital artwork we provided for a marketing campaign was not delivered on time due to a technical glitch on our server. The issue was resolved quickly, and we offered a partial refund of $1,500. The claim was settled amicably, and there are no pending disputes.
